# Morpheus patch: typed sender/date filters for matrix-sdk-search

STATUS: source only and NOT WIRED. No `[patch]` entry points at this
directory yet, so nothing builds it. Root review is required before anything
executes (see "Wiring" below).

## Upstream

- Repository: https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk
- Revision: c6ad52ecc09eaa36601f55effb0a48a533eb87dd, the revision
  `Cargo.lock` pins for `matrix-sdk-search 0.19.1`.
- Source: `crates/matrix-sdk-search` at that revision, copied read-only from
  the local cargo git checkout. The cargo cache was not modified.
- License: Apache-2.0. `LICENSE` is the repository-root license at the same
  revision; upstream copyright headers are kept in every source file.
- `MORPHEUS_PROVENANCE.json` lists every upstream file of the crate with its
  sha256, git blob ID and size, recorded before patching.
  `Cargo.toml.orig` is the upstream manifest.
- `Cargo.toml` is normalized by hand: it writes out the workspace-inherited
  `rust-version`, dependency versions and features, and lints, all from the
  upstream workspace `Cargo.toml` at the same revision. Root should compare
  it against a tool-normalized manifest (for example `cargo package`
  output). It was not generated by cargo.

## Changes

Schema, index format and stored documents are unchanged; nothing is
reindexed.

- `src/index/mod.rs`
  * `pub struct SearchFilter { sender: Option<OwnedUserId>, since:
    Option<MilliSecondsSinceUnixEpoch>, until: Option<...> }`. Its Debug
    output is redacted, and it has `is_empty()`.
  * `RoomIndex::search_filtered(query: Option<&str>, &SearchFilter, max,
    offset) -> Result<SearchResult, IndexError>`. Filter values become typed
    tantivy queries, never query-parser text:
    - a `TermQuery` on the existing `sender` STRING field;
    - a `RangeQuery` on the existing `date` field (INDEXED, FAST, second
      precision), using `Term::from_field_date_for_search`;
    - these, plus the parsed words when given, combined in a `BooleanQuery`
      with `Occur::Must`, or an `AllQuery` when nothing is set.
  * With words, hits are ordered by score, exactly like `search`. Without
    words, hits come newest first (`order_by_fast_field::<DateTime>("date",
    Desc)`) with a score of 0. The `Count` total, offset and limit behave as
    in `search`.
  * A new test, `test_search_filtered_uses_typed_sender_and_date_queries`.
    Existing tests are unchanged.
- `src/schema.rs`: `pub(crate)` accessors `sender_field()` and
  `date_field()` on `RoomMessageSchema`.

## Semantics callers must keep

- Dates are indexed to the second, so `since` and `until` select whole
  seconds. Morpheus keeps its millisecond check on loaded events.
- An edit is indexed with its own date, which is never older than its
  original's.
  * `since` keeps every edit whose original qualifies.
  * `until` can drop an edit whose original qualifies. Morpheus dates a
    message by its original, so it applies `until` only to loaded events,
    never in the index.
- Sender: an edit is accepted only from the original's sender, so an
  index-side sender term matches the same messages as before.
- Redactions remove documents exactly as before.

## Still needed: matrix-sdk (not vendored here)

The app cannot reach `RoomIndex`. `matrix_sdk::search_index::SearchIndexGuard`
keeps its map private and its `search` is `pub(crate)`, so `matrix-sdk` at
the same revision needs a matching narrow patch:

1. `crates/matrix-sdk/src/search_index/mod.rs`: add
   ```rust
   pub fn search_filtered(&mut self, query: Option<&str>,
       filter: &matrix_sdk_search::index::SearchFilter, max: usize,
       offset: Option<usize>, room_id: &RoomId) -> Result<SearchResult, IndexError>
   ```
   It mirrors the existing `search`, creating the room index when missing,
   and calls `RoomIndex::search_filtered`.
2. `Room::search_filtered(query, filter, max, offset)` next to
   `Room::search`, and an equivalent filter option on the
   `Client::search_messages` builder used for all-room search. Filters-only
   all-room search needs a per-room newest-first merge, because scores are 0.

Vendoring `matrix-sdk` (5.9 MB, many workspace-inherited dependencies and
features) needs a tool-normalized manifest. That could not be produced
without running cargo, so it is left for root.

## Wiring (after review)

- In the root `Cargo.toml`, under
  `[patch."https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk"]`, add
  `matrix-sdk-search = { path = "vendor/matrix-sdk-search" }` (and
  `matrix-sdk = { path = "vendor/matrix-sdk" }` once that exists).
- In `Cargo.lock`, the `[[package]]` entry for `matrix-sdk-search` 0.19.1
  loses its `source = "git+https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk?rev=c6ad52e...#c6ad52e..."`
  line and becomes a path package. Dependents keep listing
  `"matrix-sdk-search"`. Let cargo regenerate the lockfile, then check that
  only that identity changed.
- PERSISTENCE COHORT: `crates/morpheus-app/build.rs` hashes `vendor/`. This
  directory's existence alone, even unwired, already changes
  `MORPHEUS_PERSISTENCE_COHORT`. Root must decide whether that is acceptable
  before integrating this branch, or move the directory out of `vendor/`
  until it is wired.
